model_system: Pr-based cage compounds Pr(Ti,V,Ir)2(Al,Zn)20 with a non-Kramers Γ3 doublet on the diamond lattice; illustrative focus on PrV2Al20/Pr-based multipolar order

key_params.degrees_of_freedom: quadrupoles O20,O22 and octupole Txyz represented by pseudospin-1/2
key_params.lattice: diamond lattice, cubic space group Fd-3m, local Td symmetry
key_params.local_basis: Γ3 non-Kramers doublet from Pr3+ 4f^2 J=4 CEF states
key_params.order_parameters: AFQ φ̃, FQ φ, FO m, AFO m̃
key_params.derived_strain_scaling: εxy∝(gO/c44) m hz, with cyclic permutations
key_params.octupolar_transition_example: T*≈0.65 K mentioned for PrV2Al20 experiment

headline_claim: For magnetic field along [111] below the octupolar ordering temperature, the magnetostriction shows a linear-in-field dependence, (ΔL/L)_[111] ∝ (gO/c44) m h, so the magnetostriction coefficient is directly proportional to the ferro-octupolar order parameter.
replication_difficulty: medium - mainly a symmetry-based analytic Landau minimization, but full paper reproduction needs reconstructing all allowed invariants and phase-regime analyses.
